program_name: Bachelor of Science in Applied Physics

programme_facts.value: Are you the type of person who enjoys understanding the details of how current technologies work? Would you like to use this understanding to develop new technologies and applications? Do you want to have flexibility in choosing your career? If so, this programme might suit you.
Discover how technologies work and build real-world skills in Applied Physics with hands-on labs, industry links and a supportive, student-focused community.
A pragmatic balance between fundamental and applied aspects of physics.
